description:
About the job

Company Introduction

WorldStrides is the global leader in educational travel and experiential learning. The company was founded in 1967 to provide middle school travel programs to Washington, D.C. and has grown to provide a wide range of programs for more than half a million students annually to over 100 countries around the world. WorldStrides offers experiential learning programs in educational travel, performing arts, language immersion, career exploration, service-learning, study abroad, and sports. Each of these experiences helps students to see beyond the classroom and to see the world – and themselves – in new ways.

Job Description

The Business Development Representative (BDR) / Lead Qualifier is responsible for generating new business opportunities through high-volume outbound calls and email outreach to schools and teachers across the U.S.

In this role, you will: Proactively prospect and engage educators to introduce WorldStrides programs, qualify leads by identifying teachers interested in organizing student travel experiences, consistently meet and exceed monthly targets for calls and qualified leads, and collaborate with the Sales team by passing high-quality opportunities for closing.

This is a goal-driven, outbound sales role where success depends on your ability to handle rejection and stay motivated, build rapport quickly over the phone, maintain strong activity levels daily, and meet weekly and monthly goals in order to achieve additional compensation through a set commission structure.

You’ll work with a wide range of educational travel programs (history, science, national parks, and more), giving you constant opportunities to connect with new prospects and refine your sales and communication skills.

Responsibilities


Make calls and leave messages for teachers nationwide and use talk tracks for live calls.
Send follow-up emails.
Work on special projects, including periodic competitive calls, calls to unassigned schools, specialty schools and other telemarketing efforts.
Periodically research schools to help identify top prospects and maintain the database. Use templates to create and send flyers and update PowerPoint presentations.


Qualifications


Desired work experience in sales, marketing, promotions or telemarketing.
Proficiency in relevant computer applications including CRM.
Desired knowledge of customer service/sales principles and practices.
Six months or more experience in sales/lead creation/lead qualifying with Telephone sales experience preferred
Good data entry/keyboard skills
Familiar with office rules/office environment
High school diploma or GED required
Advanced (85%+) English level
Desired knowledge of sales and marketing principles and strategies
Proactive
Organized


Work Perks


Fun & driven environment.
Excellent medical, dental, and vision coverage, life, accidental death and dismemberment, accident, critical illness, and disability insurance.
+10% of gross salary as food stamps.
1 paid volunteer day & 25 PTO* days to start – accrue up to 28 over 3 years, 4 mental health days, and 5 bereavement days.
Statutory Holidays by Mexican Federal Labor Law.
Tuition reimbursement up to five thousand, two hundred fifty dollars annually or one thousand dollars towards professional certification annually.
Flexible work schedule providing on-site and hybrid opportunities.
Encouraged participation in our Employee Resource Groups and Diversity, Equity, & Inclusion council.
Fitness opportunities. Employee Assistance Program (EAP)
Paid statutory parental leave.


WorldStrides, a global organization, is committed to educate and serve communities worldwide. Our commitment is fueled by the passion of our team members and partners to make experiential learning accessible, while also being socially, environmentally, and ethically responsible. Together, we accomplish this by investing in initiatives to promote inclusion, diversity, and sustainability.

As an Equal Opportunity Employer, WorldStrides is committed to building a diverse workforce, supported by an environment that promotes inclusion and belonging. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state, or local laws.

WorldStrides will only employ those who are legally authorized to work in the United States. This is not a position for which sponsorship will be provided. Individuals with temporary visas such as E, F-1, J-1, H-1, H-2, L, B, J or TN, or who need sponsorship for work authorization now or in the future, are not eligible for hire. Select seasonal roles may consider students on J-1 or F-1 visas.

description:
About the job

About Us




Vidovo is a UGC and creator marketing platform. Brands come to us to get creator content that performs in paid social; creators come to us to work with real brands and get paid on time.

We've worked with 400+ brands, including NerdWallet, OLIPOP, Physician's Choice, and Mid Day Squares, with a marketplace of 32,000+ creators.




Role Description




You'll edit performance-focused video ads for Meta, TikTok, Instagram, and other paid social channels.




Most videos are 30–60 seconds, with occasional 3–5 minute ads. This is a high-volume role, so you'll need to work quickly while maintaining quality across 100+ videos per month.




You'll take raw UGC and turn it into finished ads with strong pacing, subtitles, B-roll, product visuals, graphics, and other engaging elements. You'll also create variations by swapping hooks, intros, CTAs, and clips.




What you'll do:




Edit short-form UGC and performance ads
Turn raw creator footage into polished, ready-to-launch creatives
Add subtitles, B-roll, graphics, screenshots, sound effects, and compelling visuals
Create multiple variations by swapping hooks, intros, clips, and CTAs
Bulk edit and version creatives efficiently
Use Higgsfield AI to expand 9:16 footage into natural-looking 16:9 versions
Resize creatives for different platforms and placements
Handle revisions quickly and keep files and versions organized




What we're looking for:




Experience editing UGC, short-form content, social media, or paid ads
Strong understanding of TikTok, Instagram Reels, Meta ads, and modern short-form editing
Excellent sense of pacing, hooks, subtitles, and visual storytelling
Comfortable working at high volume — 100+ videos per month
Experience with Premiere Pro, DaVinci Resolve, Final Cut Pro, CapCut, or similar
Comfortable learning AI creative tools; Higgsfield experience is a plus
Organized, reliable, and able to move quickly
Able to take feedback and turn revisions around fast




You'd Be Great at This Role If:




You can tell when the first few seconds of an ad are too slow. You know when a talking-head video needs another visual to hold attention. You can take one piece of raw footage and see multiple ad variations inside of it.




Most importantly, you know how to edit for performance, not just aesthetics.




Here's an example of the level and style we're looking for:

https://drive.google.com/file/d/1CuQ0adx91CnfORv_ibrcCyV4nNLYblok/view?usp=sharing




We're looking for someone who can become a dependable part of Vidovo's creative production workflow as our managed creative services continue to grow.

description:
About the job

About Turn


Turn is a venture-backed B2B software company built for the realities of high-volume hiring. Our platform runs pre-employment background checks and continuous monitoring, and integrates directly into the systems employers already hire with — so teams in hospitality, staffing, construction, healthcare, and real estate can screen candidates fast without giving up compliance. We’re a small, fully remote team that moves quickly and ships real things.



About the Role


We’re looking for a hands-on Growth Marketing Engineer to own our full-funnel demand engine and turn the traffic and buying signals we already generate into qualified demos and pipeline.




You’ll sit at the intersection of performance marketing, marketing operations, conversion optimization, and analytics, building and running the systems that move a prospect from first touch to booked meeting. This is a builder’s role: you’ll spend your days in the ad platforms, the CRM, the analytics tools, and the page builder, shipping changes and measuring their impact on qualified-demo volume and pipeline.


What You’ll Do



Paid acquisition: Plan, launch, and optimize paid campaigns (Google Ads — Performance Max and Search, LinkedIn), architecting campaign structure, audience targeting, and conversion-event mapping so spend optimizes toward booked demos and pipeline rather than clicks, with clean, server-imported conversion tracking (enhanced/offline conversions from the CRM).


Conversion rate optimization: Build and A/B test dedicated demo landing pages, landing pages, forms, and CTAs that turn visitors into meetings, including persona-aware routing (buyer vs. candidate vs. partner) across the site, and own the on-site demo path.


Marketing operations & RevOps: Own the full lead lifecycle and the automation behind it — CRM workflows, lifecycle-stage instrumentation, lead scoring and routing, and the visitor-signal-to-outbound engine across HubSpot, Amplemarket, RB2B, Duo, and Zapier. Build and scale the loop that turns identified in-market website visitors into timely, signal-based 1:1 outreach.


Email deliverability & infrastructure: Own outbound sending infrastructure — mailbox and domain strategy, warm-up and rotation, pre-send verification, and deliverability health — so outreach lands in the inbox and protects the primary domain’s reputation.


Analytics & reporting: Build and own the measurement layer end to end — define the key conversion events, GA4, UTM governance, conversion validation — and build the dashboards that tie marketing activity to pipeline and revenue (Mode).


Conversion copywriting: Write the ad, landing-page, and signal-based outbound copy that drives response.



What You’ll Need



Hands-on experience across growth marketing, demand generation, marketing operations, or revenue operations — ideally in B2B SaaS. You’re a builder who works inside the tools, not only a strategist.


Real performance-marketing experience, especially Google Ads (including Performance Max and Search campaign structure), with a habit of optimizing toward CAC and pipeline instead of vanity metrics.


Fluency with a modern marketing / CRM automation stack (we use HubSpot, Amplemarket, RB2B, Intercom, Zapier, and Calendly; comparable tools like Salesforce, Marketo, or Make are fine).


Analytics chops: GA4, disciplined UTM and conversion tracking, and enough SQL / BI to build your own dashboards (we use Mode; Looker, Amplitude, or similar is fine).


CRO instincts and conversion copywriting ability.


A data-driven, experimental, self-directed way of working — you read the funnel, ship the fix, and measure the result.


Bilingual Spanish/English, with fluent written English.





This is our ideal profile, not a checklist. If you can do the work, we’d love to hear from you regardless of years or title.


Success Metrics (First 6–12 Months)



Growth in qualified demos and marketing-sourced pipeline, at flat or lower cost per acquisition.


Higher conversion rates across the funnel, from visitor to demo to booked meeting.


A larger share of best-fit (ICP) traffic reached and converted.


Strong outbound deliverability and healthy sending infrastructure across all domains.


A reliable weekly reporting cadence that ties marketing activity to pipeline.



Nice to Have



Experience in HR tech, workforce, background screening, or compliance-adjacent categories.


Account-based marketing (ABM) and audience segmentation.


Server-side, enhanced, or offline conversion tracking (e.g. CAPI).


Outbound email deliverability at scale — multi-domain/mailbox management, warm-up, and inbox placement.


Technical SEO and simple creative for ads and social.



Perks & Compensation



Competitive salary (base range shared early in the process)


Major medical health insurance


Paid time off


Remote work with occasional in-office training and in-person meetings

description:
About the job

Business Development Representative | SaaS, FinTech & Tecnología | Prospección Outbound & Eventos 

Para nuestro cliente, una empresa internacional de tecnología especializada en comunicaciones en la nube, soluciones de contact center y automatización de interacciones con clientes, estamos en búsqueda de un/a Business Development Representative (BDR) – Outbound B2B para integrarse a su equipo comercial en México.




Esta posición es ideal para una persona con mentalidad hunter, experiencia en prospección outbound y capacidad para generar nuevas oportunidades comerciales en sectores B2B, especialmente dentro de tecnología, SaaS, fintech, contact center, CPaaS o soluciones de comunicación empresarial.

La persona seleccionada será responsable de identificar y contactar empresas objetivo, abrir conversaciones con tomadores de decisión, calificar oportunidades y agendar reuniones comerciales para el equipo, manteniendo una gestión ordenada y precisa del pipeline en CRM.




LO QUE BUSCAMOS EN NUESTRO/A CANDIDATO/A IDEAL:

1. A partir de 2+ años de experiencia en roles de prospección comercial, generación de leads outbound o desarrollo de ventas B2B. 

2. Experiencia deseable en sectores como tecnología B2B, SaaS, Fintech, contact center, CPaaS, cloud communications, soluciones digitales o servicios tecnológicos para empresas. 

3. Experiencia previa como Representante Comercial, Ejecutivo Comercial, SDR, BDR, Sales Development, Lead Generation o posiciones similares.

4. Mentalidad hunter y fuerte orientación a resultados, con comodidad para hacer contacto en frío, buscar nuevos prospectos y abrir puertas con tomadores de decisión. 

5. Capacidad para identificar empresas objetivo, entender el perfil de cliente ideal y calificar oportunidades comerciales de manera estructurada. 

6. Buenas habilidades de comunicación para explicar soluciones tecnológicas de forma clara, consultiva y profesional. 

7. Experiencia trabajando con CRM, registrando actividades, conversaciones, próximos pasos y avance de oportunidades de manera ordenada y constante. 

8. Perfil organizado, proactivo, coachable y con actitud madura para representar a la empresa en primeras conversaciones comerciales y eventos de la industria. 

9. Inglés intermedio, suficiente para comunicarse con equipo internacional y entender información comercial del producto. 




FUNCIONES PRINCIPALES DEL PUESTO:

1) Realizar prospección outbound a empresas objetivo definidas por la compañía. 

2) Contactar a prospectos a través de canales como LinkedIn, email, llamadas y otros medios comerciales. 

3) Representar a la empresa de manera profesional en eventos, conferencias y espacios de networking de la industria, realizando prospección activa y no solo atención pasiva de contactos.

4) Identificar y abrir conversaciones con los tomadores de decisión adecuados dentro de cada empresa. 

5) Calificar oportunidades comerciales, entendiendo las necesidades del prospecto, el fit con la solución y el potencial de negocio. 

6) Mantener información clara, completa y actualizada en el CRM sobre actividades, conversaciones, próximos pasos y avance de cada cuenta. 

7) Dar seguimiento constante a prospectos y oportunidades en etapa inicial del proceso comercial. 

8) Proponer nuevas empresas objetivo cuando identifique oportunidades relevantes dentro del mercado. 




¿POR QUÉ UNIRTE A ESTE EQUIPO?

· Se ofrece una compensación altamente competitiva, de acuerdo con tu experiencia y perfil, junto con un atractivo esquema de bonos basado en resultados, porque las contribuciones sólidas deben ser realmente recompensadas.

· En este rol tendrás la posibilidad de participar directamente en la expansión comercial de la compañía en México, trabajando con un producto tecnológico de alto valor y con un equipo internacional orientado a resultados, aprendizaje y crecimiento profesional.

· Además, es una posición ideal si buscas desarrollar una carrera comercial en tecnología B2B, fortalecer tus habilidades de prospección outbound, aprender sobre soluciones complejas y tener exposición real a clientes, eventos de la industria y procesos comerciales consultivos.

· La empresa ofrece un entorno dinámico, flexible y de baja burocracia, donde se valora la responsabilidad, la iniciativa, la transparencia, la capacidad de aprendizaje y la ejecución constante.




TRES CLAVES PARA EL ÉXITO EN ESTA POSICIÓN

1) Mentalidad hunter y fuerte capacidad de prospección outbound

2) Disciplina comercial y excelente manejo de CRM

3) Coachability, profesionalismo y confianza para representar a la empresa

Si te identificas con este rol y te motiva la oportunidad de generar nuevas conversaciones comerciales, abrir puertas con empresas objetivo y contribuir al crecimiento de una compañía internacional de tecnología en México y LATAM, nos encantará conocerte: cv@tk-recruitment.com

title: Senior Fullstack Ruby on Rails Developer
skills: 5+ years of production experience building and scaling applications using Ruby on Rails (Rails 6/7) and modern Ruby 3.x features.
Strong proficiency with frontend assets in Rails. This includes deep experience with Hotwire (Turbo/Stimulus) OR modern SPA frameworks like React.js or Vue.js connected via a Rails API.
Deep knowledge of PostgreSQL or MySQL, specifically in writing complex ActiveRecord queries, optimizing indexes, and managing database migrations safely at scale.
Extensive experience managing background jobs, race conditions, and heavy data processing using Sidekiq and Redis.
A strict habit of writing maintainable test suites using RSpec, Capybara, or FactoryBot to ensure high test coverage and stable deployments.
Proven track record of designing, securing, and documenting clean RESTful APIs.
Solid understanding of Git workflows, Docker containerization, and asset compilation pipelines (Propshaft, Webpacker, or Vite Ruby).
Experience migrating legacy Rails applications to newer versions.
Familiarity with cloud platforms (AWS, Heroku, or Render) and CI/CD pipelines.
Understanding of domain-driven patterns within Rails to keep large codebases decoupled.
Knowledge of web security best practices (OWASP Top 10, cross-site scripting prevention).
Design, architect, and implement clean, test-driven features across both the backend and frontend layers.
Profile and optimize slow queries, eliminate N+1 query bugs, and optimize frontend rendering paths to keep application response times low.
Participate in rigorous peer code reviews, championing idiomatic Ruby patterns, security protocols, and robust architectural choices.
Act as a technical sounding board for Product and Design teams, helping evaluate the technical feasibility of upcoming features.
Assist in maintaining and improving deployment workflows to ensure reliable, zero-downtime releases.

About the job

About us:




Talent has no borders. Proxify's mission is to connect top developers around the world with opportunities they deserve. So, it doesn't matter where you are; we are here to help you fast-track your independent career in the right direction. 🙂




Since our launch, Proxify's developers have successfully worked with 1200+ happy clients to build their products and growth features. 5000+ talented developers trust Proxify and its network to fulfill their dreams and objectives.




Proxify is shaped by a global network of supportive, talented developers interested in remote full-time jobs. Our Glassdoor (4.5/5) and Trustpilot (4.8/5) ratings reflect the trust developers place in us and our commitment to our members' success.




The Role:




We are looking for a Senior Fullstack Ruby on Rails Developer to join one of our high-growth client teams. In this role, you will be a key driver of the application's lifecycle, writing clean, idiomatic Ruby code to build robust backend features while ensuring a smooth, highly interactive frontend user experience.




You will help the client leverage the "Rails way" to ship features quickly, without sacrificing long-term maintainability, testability, or performance. This is an ideal position for a developer who appreciates the elegant architecture of Rails but understands how to optimize database queries, scale background workers, and deliver a modern interface.







What we are looking for:




5+ years of production experience building and scaling applications using Ruby on Rails (Rails 6/7) and modern Ruby 3.x features.
Strong proficiency with frontend assets in Rails. This includes deep experience with Hotwire (Turbo/Stimulus) OR modern SPA frameworks like React.js or Vue.js connected via a Rails API.
Deep knowledge of PostgreSQL or MySQL, specifically in writing complex ActiveRecord queries, optimizing indexes, and managing database migrations safely at scale.
Extensive experience managing background jobs, race conditions, and heavy data processing using Sidekiq and Redis.
A strict habit of writing maintainable test suites using RSpec, Capybara, or FactoryBot to ensure high test coverage and stable deployments.
Proven track record of designing, securing, and documenting clean RESTful APIs.
Solid understanding of Git workflows, Docker containerization, and asset compilation pipelines (Propshaft, Webpacker, or Vite Ruby).







Nice-to-Have:




Experience migrating legacy Rails applications to newer versions.
Familiarity with cloud platforms (AWS, Heroku, or Render) and CI/CD pipelines.
Understanding of domain-driven patterns within Rails to keep large codebases decoupled.
Knowledge of web security best practices (OWASP Top 10, cross-site scripting prevention).







Responsibilities:




Design, architect, and implement clean, test-driven features across both the backend and frontend layers.
Profile and optimize slow queries, eliminate N+1 query bugs, and optimize frontend rendering paths to keep application response times low.
Participate in rigorous peer code reviews, championing idiomatic Ruby patterns, security protocols, and robust architectural choices.
Act as a technical sounding board for Product and Design teams, helping evaluate the technical feasibility of upcoming features.
Assist in maintaining and improving deployment workflows to ensure reliable, zero-downtime releases.

description:
About the job

Building the Future of Open Finance

Payward - the parent company behind Kraken, NinjaTrader, Breakout, xStocks, Payward Services and CF Benchmarks - has spent the last 15 years building one of the most modern and globally accessible financial infrastructure platforms in the industry, built to advance an open, global financial system.

Before you apply, we encourage you to explore our culture page to understand what drives us and how we work.

The team

Founded in 2011, Kraken is one of the world's longest-standing crypto platforms, trusted by over 10 million individuals and institutions across the globe. It offers spot trading, margin, futures, staking, and OTC services, with products built for both individual investors and institutional clients.

The Pro team is responsible for everything to do with the trading backend services such as the matching engine, market data gateways, internal and external APIs, and various other trading services. The team is located globally and responsibilities are split into sub-teams, working with various tech stacks. Our teams code in Rust and work agile around the globe.

The Opportunity


Design and implement robust Rust services and libraries that power trading, payments, and crypto experiences with a focus on reliability, performance, and user impact.
Write reusable, testable, and highly efficient code that scales across teams and supports revenue-critical systems without compromising safety or security.
Collaborate on large-scale distributed systems architecture, translating evolving product requirements into resilient, low-latency solutions.
Work alongside hundreds of experienced Rust engineers, contributing to a high-performance, product-driven engineering culture.


What You Bring


7+ years of software engineering experience
Experience building financial trading focused products
Proficient in writing network services or asynchronous code in Rust
Have a security-first mindset during system design to ensure robustness
Demonstrate the ability to autonomously debug issues across the stack (OS, network, application)
Apply a solid understanding of distributed systems and technologies, including RPC protocols, Kafka, and Event-Driven Systems, to design scalable solutions
Collaborate effectively with product teams to gather requirements and constraints for designing appropriate systems
Take complete end-to-end ownership of systems and libraries
Provide mentorship to other engineers while contributing to defining the technical culture


Unless a specific application deadline is stated in the job posting, applications are accepted on an ongoing basis.

Please note, applicants are permitted to redact or remove information on their resume that identifies age, date of birth, or dates of attendance at or graduation from an educational institution.

We consider qualified applicants with criminal histories for employment on our team, assessing candidates in a manner consistent with the requirements of the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance.

Our commitment

Payward is powered by people from around the world and we celebrate the diverse talents, backgrounds, contributions, and unique perspectives that everyone brings to the table. We hire based on merit, seeking out people with the right abilities, knowledge, and skills for the job. We encourage you to apply for roles where you don't fully meet the listed requirements, especially if you're passionate or knowledgeable about crypto.

We may ask candidates to complete job-related skills or work-style assessments as part of our hiring process. These assessments evaluate competencies relevant to the role and are applied consistently across candidates for similar positions. Results are considered alongside experience and interviews, and are not the sole basis for any employment decision.

As an equal opportunity employer, we don't tolerate discrimination or harassment of any kind, whether based on race, ethnicity, age, gender identity, citizenship, religion, sexual orientation, disability, pregnancy, veteran status, or any other protected characteristic as outlined by federal, state, or local laws.

About Delinea

Delinea is a pioneer in securing human and machine identities through intelligent, centralized authorization, empowering organizations to seamlessly govern their interactions across the modern enterprise. Join our passionate, global team at Delinea and help us make the world a safer and more secure place. Our success is driven by world-class product leadership, outstanding engineers, and strategic investment from TPG. We value diversity, innovation, and a culture of respect and fairness. Apply today to help us achieve our mission.

Delinea is seeking a Product Manager to join our Platform team, driving the product roadmap in close collaboration with product owners, designers, and technical writers across the Product Management Group. In this role, you will help refine and execute the vision for Secret Server by partnering with cross-functional teams throughout planning, development, and release. Work with an international team solving real business payment challenges across markets. You will gain hands-on exposure to cross-border payments and stablecoin infrastructure while directly contributing to better customer experiences, smarter workflows, and more effective support operations.

Collaborate with our internal Marketing and Media Performance teams, as well as agency partners, to shape acquisition, CRM, and paid media strategies that effectively reach and engage Mexican consumers. - Drive cross-functional commercial alignment across B2B, Retail, Marketing, Media, Merchandising, Finance and Operations to ensure a connected omnichannel experience and cohesive execution. - Represent the Mexico digital business within LATAM, Americas and Global teams, bringing local market insights into regional and global strategies while ensuring global priorities are effectively translated to the Mexican market. - Lead ongoing business performance reviews, turning data and insights into clear priorities and actions, challenging the status quo and continuously raising digital commercial performance.



 Your story 


 8+ years of experience leading digital commerce strategy for premium brands, with expert knowledge of the Mexican e-commerce ecosystem, including local marketplaces, payment methods, and fulfillment networks. - Experience in the sports industry and/or Global Apparel premium brands is strongly preferred. - In-depth experience operating within an owned distributed business model and navigating complex local e-commerce landscapes. - Proven track record of effective cross-functional collaboration with Media Performance, Merchandising, Demand & Supply Planning, Buyers, Marketing, B2B, and Retail teams. - Strong ability to thrive in a dynamic environment and partner seamlessly with regional (LATAM, Americas) and Global stakeholder teams. - Fluency in Spanish and English is required. - Strong commercial acumen with solid analytical skills in e-commerce metrics, financial forecasting, and user journey optimization.

description:
About the job

Job Description

The Senior Associate, Cyber Operations will join the Cyber Operations / Incident Response team and will be responsible for investigating, managing, and documenting cybersecurity incidents within a 24x7 security operations environment.

Key Responsibilities

Monitor, investigate, and respond to cybersecurity alerts and incidents, identifying potential threats and assessing their impact on the organization.
Manage security incidents throughout the Incident Response lifecycle, including identification, containment, eradication, recovery, and lessons learned.
Investigate security events using Endpoint Detection & Response (EDR) technologies such as CrowdStrike, Microsoft Defender for Endpoint (MDE), Zscaler, or equivalent platforms.
Support threat identification, incident investigation, containment, and remediation activities.
Document incident findings, investigation details, actions taken, and resolution outcomes.
Use ServiceNow or similar platforms for incident ticketing, tracking, and case management.
Support investigations related to email security threats such as phishing and malicious emails using tools such as Proofpoint or equivalent technologies.
Leverage Threat Intelligence platforms, such as Recorded Future or equivalent solutions, to identify Indicators of Compromise (IOCs) and support incident investigations.
Work within a predominantly Microsoft Azure environment and support security monitoring and incident response activities across cloud-based systems.
Use scripting, preferably Python or Shell Script, to automate small repetitive security tasks when applicable.
Support security automation and orchestration activities using Cortex XSOAR or equivalent SOAR platforms when required.
Stay current with cybersecurity threats, technologies, and security practices and contribute to continuous improvement of incident response processes and controls.

Job Requirements

Must-have

3–5 years of hands-on experience in Cybersecurity Incident Response / Incident Management.
Experience investigating and responding to cybersecurity alerts and incidents.
Hands-on experience with EDR technologies, such as CrowdStrike, Microsoft Defender for Endpoint (MDE), Zscaler, or equivalent platforms.
Solid understanding of the Incident Response lifecycle: Preparation, Identification, Containment, Eradication, Recovery, and Lessons Learned.
Ability to document incidents, investigations, actions taken, findings, and outcomes.
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
Excellent verbal and written English communication skills.
Availability to work rotating schedules according to operational needs, with schedule changes approximately every quarter.
Availability to work 100% remotely.

Preferred / Nice to Have

Experience with ServiceNow for security incident ticketing and case management.
Experience working in Microsoft Azure environments; approximately 80–90% of the current environment is Azure-based.
Basic scripting experience, preferably Python; Shell Script is also valuable.
Experience with Proofpoint or equivalent email security platforms.
Experience with Recorded Future or other Threat Intelligence platforms, including working with Indicators of Compromise (IOCs).
Experience with Cortex XSOAR or another SOAR platform for security automation and orchestration.
Exposure to Threat Hunting and Digital Forensics.

Preferred Certifications

Certifications are desirable but not mandatory. Particularly valued certifications include:

GCIH – GIAC Certified Incident Handler
GCFE – GIAC Certified Forensic Examiner
GCFA – GIAC Certified Forensic Analyst
Microsoft Azure certifications, such as AZ-900 – Microsoft Azure Fundamentals

Other relevant cybersecurity certifications may also be considered.

About the job

Hey there — yeah, you!




HomeHop is a fast-growing short-term rental management company (think Airbnb & VRBO), and we're on the hunt for a friendly, quick-thinking individual to be the voice our guests hear when they reach out. We started with a handful of properties and now manage 140+ short-term rentals across the Midwest USA… and we're still just getting started!




If you love solving problems, thrive when things move fast, and get a little thrill from checking things off a list — keep reading.




What you'll actually be doing

You'll be our guest's go-to person. Someone messages asking where to park, how the hot tub works, or whether they can check in early? You've got them — warm, fast, and helpful every time. Guest messaging is a big part of this role… but it's not the whole role.




Because we're a startup, no two shifts look the same. One minute you're smoothing over a booking question, the next you're helping the team knock out a random task that keeps the whole machine running. We wear a lot of hats around here, and we're looking for someone who's happy to grab one and jump in.




A taste of the day-to-day:

Chatting with guests across Airbnb, VRBO, and our direct booking channels — keeping it prompt, professional, and genuinely friendly
Handling reservations, questions, and the occasional "help, I locked myself out" moment
Coordinating with cleaning and maintenance crews to keep stays running smoothly
Jumping in on all kinds of team tasks and projects as we grow — flexibility is the name of the game
Keeping notes and records tidy so nothing slips through the cracks
Using critical thinking when problems with guests arise




The schedule:

Friday, Saturday, Sunday, Monday 7:00 AM – 5:00 PM EST
You'll need to work on American holidays (guests travel most when everyone else is off)
5 days of PTO to start




You'll fit right in if you…

Write like a real, warm human — clear, kind, and typo-free
Stay cool under pressure and can juggle a few things at once
Are tech-savvy and comfortable bouncing between apps and platforms
Have experience with short-term rentals or Airbnb (a big plus!)
Are based in Mexico and ready to work fully remote
Actually like helping people




Why HomeHop?

We're a small, scrappy, supportive team that believes work should be fun — not a corporate snooze-fest. We move fast, we back each other up, we celebrate wins, and there's real room to grow as we do!




Ready to hop in?

Hit apply and tell us a little about yourself. We can't wait to meet you!!

Educational: Tax tips, compliance reminders, financial literacy.

Track KPIs specifically related to brand awareness and MQLs (Marketing Qualified Leads).
Use AI-supported analysis and strong marketing judgment to identify patterns, content opportunities, and areas for improvement.
Suggest experiments or new formats to increase reach among our ideal clients: business owners with $1M+ revenue and Hispanic entrepreneurs looking to register an LLC in the US.
Document learnings from content tests and translate them into actionable improvements for future content.

-Short-form editing (Premiere Pro, CapCut, or Final Cut).

-Find Solutions: Ability to operate quickly and solve creative problems without constant supervision.

Results (Success Metrics)

title: Loyalty Manager
description:
About the job

Bullfinch Recruitment are proud to be partnering with a high-growth social gaming business, delivering innovative, scalable products to a global player base, who are looking for a Loyalty Manager to join their team.




What you'll do: 

● Proactive Outreach: Drive revenue and retention by conducting regular outbound calls to

your portfolio of top-tier players, identifying opportunities to deepen engagement and present

tailored offers that convert.

● Relationship Management: Act as the primary advocate and concierge for your players,

building the trust and rapport that makes every sales conversation feel natural rather than

transactional.

● Bespoke Offer Creation: Use your knowledge of player preferences and play patterns to

design and pitch unique, tailored rewards and incentives, treating every offer as a sales

opportunity to increase player value and loyalty.

● Needs-Based Selling: Proactively identify what each player needs, whether that's

reassurance, a specific reward, or a resolution and address it directly, turning every interaction

into a chance to strengthen the relationship and drive results.

● Query Resolution: Draw on strong customer service instincts to act as the subject matter

expert for player inquiries regarding rewards, loyalty programs, and account benefits, resolving

issues swiftly so trust stays intact and the door stays open for the next offer.

● Player Requests: Monitor and facilitate withdrawal requests for your players, ensuring a

smooth, prioritized experience that reinforces confidence in the relationship.

● Player Advocacy: Collaborate with internal teams to ensure player feedback is heard and

their needs are met across all touchpoints feeding insights back into future offer strategy.

What we're looking for

● Sales Mindset: A natural at spotting opportunities in conversation and confidently guiding

players toward offers that genuinely benefit them, comfortable with outbound calling as a core

part of the role.

● Customer Service Background: Prior experience in a CS or player-facing support roles, with

a demonstrated ability to attend to player needs, resolve issues empathetically, and turn

problems into positive outcomes.

● Interpersonal Excellence: Fluent in English, able to communicate with confidence, empathy,

and persuasion over the phone and via written channels.

● Accountability: You take pride in owning a problem and an opportunity from start to finish.

Reliable, and you follow through on every promise made to a player.

● Discretion & Judgment: Ability to make informed decisions on custom rewards and player

requests within company guidelines, balancing player satisfaction with commercial impact.

Employer Branding Analyst at BairesDev

description:
About the job

Asesor Comercial B2B | Monterrey

Monterrey, Nuevo León

En FARZ buscamos un Asesor Comercial B2B para hacer crecer nuestra presencia en Monterrey y su área metropolitana.

Somos una empresa mexicana fabricante de persianas, cortinas, toldos y pérgolas, con planta en Los Altos de Jalisco y una red de distribuidores que atiende el mercado nacional. Nuestras soluciones de control solar están presentes en proyectos residenciales, comerciales y arquitectónicos, trabajando de la mano con distribuidores, arquitectos, interioristas, diseñadores y desarrolladores.

La posición es principalmente de campo. Buscamos a alguien que conozca cómo se mueve el mercado, disfrute visitar clientes, abrir nuevas cuentas y dar seguimiento comercial hasta concretar una venta.




¿Qué harás?

Tendrás responsabilidad sobre una zona comercial y una cartera de distribuidores. Una parte importante de tu trabajo será mantener y hacer crecer las cuentas actuales, pero también salir al mercado a generar negocio nuevo.

En el día a día:

Prospectarás nuevos distribuidores y clientes B2B.
Visitarás regularmente a los clientes de tu zona.
Identificarás cuentas con potencial y oportunidades para nuevos productos.
Prepararás propuestas y cotizaciones y les darás seguimiento hasta el cierre.
Organizarás tus rutas y prioridades de visita.
Asesorarás y capacitarás a distribuidores sobre las soluciones FARZ.
Mantendrás seguimiento de oportunidades, compromisos, cobranza y necesidades de postventa.
Revisarás el comportamiento de tu cartera para decidir dónde concentrar tu esfuerzo.
Darás seguimiento a tus resultados y, cuando sea necesario, propondrás acciones para recuperar la meta.

El descriptivo vigente del puesto establece indicadores concretos como venta real vs. meta, prospección, desarrollo de clientes, cumplimiento de rutas, presupuesto y productos nuevos.




¿Qué buscamos?

3 años o más de experiencia en ventas.
Escolaridad: Licenciatura o ingeniería, preferentemente en Administración, Mercadotecnia, Negocios, Arquitectura, Diseño de Interiores, Ingeniería Industrial, Civil o áreas afines.
Experiencia en ventas B2B, manejo de distribuidores, desarrollo de territorio o cuentas comerciales.
Capacidad para prospectar, negociar y cerrar.
Orden y constancia para dar seguimiento a clientes y oportunidades.
Facilidad para trabajar con metas e información comercial.
Autonomía para organizar una zona y responsabilidad sobre los resultados.
Disponibilidad para trabajar principalmente en campo.
Residencia en Monterrey o su área metropolitana.

Nos interesa especialmente conocer personas con experiencia en control solar, cortinas y persianas, vidrio, productos arquitectónicos, construcción, acabados, iluminación, mobiliario, automatización o soluciones comercializadas a través de distribuidores.

La experiencia específica en nuestro giro suma, pero también valoramos a quien venga de un mercado relacionado y pueda demostrar que sabe abrir cuentas y desarrollar un territorio.




¿Qué encontrarás en FARZ?

Una empresa fabricante con presencia nacional que está fortaleciendo su operación comercial y su red de distribuidores. FARZ opera actualmente mediante 12 zonas comerciales en México.

El puesto ofrece espacio para conocer a fondo tu mercado, construir relaciones comerciales de largo plazo y asumir responsabilidad directa sobre el crecimiento de tu zona.

Trabajamos con metas e indicadores, pero esperamos también criterio comercial e iniciativa para identificar dónde está la oportunidad y actuar sobre ella.

Si conoces el mercado de Monterrey y puedes demostrar que has hecho crecer clientes, cuentas o una zona comercial, nos interesa conocerte.

Al postularte, cuéntanos brevemente:

¿Qué cliente, cartera o territorio has desarrollado y cuál fue el resultado?

title: Senior Salesforce CRM Developer
skills: 5+ years of dedicated, hands-on development experience across Salesforce Sales Cloud and Service Cloud, with expert-level proficiency in Apex (classes, triggers, batch jobs, queueables) and Lightning Web Components (LWC).

Advanced knowledge of SOQL and SOSL, with a proven ability to design scalable data models (custom objects, junction objects, big objects) while optimizing queries to prevent governor limit exceptions in high-volume environments.

Extensive experience building, consuming, and securing external web services using REST/SOAP APIs, Named Credentials, OAuth2 authorization flows, and platform event integration (Pub/Sub API, MuleSoft).
Strong mastery of enterprise design patterns in Apex (Trigger Frameworks, Service Layer, Selector Layer, Domain Layer) and declarative vs. programmatic trade-off analysis.
Hands-on experience with Salesforce CLI, source-driven development (SFDX), Git workflows, unit testing enforcing >85% code coverage, and CI/CD tools (Copado, Gearset, or GitHub Actions).
Active Salesforce Certified Platform Developer I & II (PD1 / PD2) certifications are highly preferred.
Strong communication skills in English, both written and verbal.
Experience with Salesforce CPQ, OmniStudio (Vlocity), or Experience Cloud implementations.
Certifications such as Salesforce Certified Data Architecture & Management Designer or Integration Architecture Designer.
Exposure to Data Cloud (CDP), CRM Analytics (Tableau CRM/Einstein Analytics), or AI features (Agentforce/Einstein 1).
Background in migrating legacy Visualforce pages and Aura components to modern LWC.
Design, write, and maintain high-quality Apex code, custom LWC user interfaces, and asynchronous backend processing frameworks.
Architect and build secure, bidirectional integrations between Salesforce and third-party enterprise platforms (e.g., SAP, HubSpot, BigQuery) using REST/SOAP APIs and middleware.
Profile execution logs, optimize complex trigger handlers, and refactor inefficient legacy code to guarantee rapid page loads and bulk data processing stability.
Manage source-driven deployments using Salesforce CLI and Git-based CI/CD pipelines, ensuring safe environment sandbox management and release predictability.
Partner with Salesforce Architects, Business Analysts, and product owners to translate enterprise business needs into robust, scalable technical blueprints.
